purpose: Summer fashion editorial with adult blond male and female models; preserve existing garments and brand art. Styling is not a new SKU. Practical LED light is not luminous fabric.

images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Luxury independent summer streetwear campaign for ARCHIVO, SALITRE x ISLA BRAVA. LANDSCAPE 3:2 fashion photograph, two clearly adult BLOND models, an elegant 30-year-old man with golden sandy-blond loose side part and a 28-year-old woman with long honey-blond hair tied in a low loose bun. Natural confident direct gaze, sophisticated ease, not stiff catalog poses. Reference 1 is the exact SALITRE ivory short-sleeve open-collar shirt, preserve its tiny turquoise horizon on left chest and actual buttoned garment design; man wears it with strong turquoise tailored shorts and dark brown refined sandals, shirt loosely untucked so micro mark visible. Reference 2 is the exact ISLA BRAVA papaya-orange short-sleeve shirt with two dark red five-petal flowers; woman wears it buttoned, open neck, with lavender high-waist tailored shorts, minimal gold earrings, no purse covering print. The two stand a little apart outside a sunlit seaside modernist guesthouse with cobalt-blue ceramic door, sun-yellow wall accent, rough white stucco, chipped terracotta paving, distant Mediterranean-like sea, subtle breeze. Both fully visible from head through footwear, generous breathing room top and sides, faces and prints sharp. 35mm full frame f/5.6, natural 10am sunlight softened by shade, warm clear color, cotton weave, real pores, baby hairs and normal wrinkles, fine cinematic grain, absolutely believable human fashion editorial. Joyful vivid turquoise, orange, lavender and ivory palette balanced with calm architecture. No sunglasses hiding eyes, no brand labels on styling accessories, no extra clothing changes, no outside typography, cigarette, plastic CGI skin, watermark or collage.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. ARCHIVO high-summer color-block fashion editorial, LANDSCAPE 3:2 photograph of two new adult BLOND models, clearly different people from a resort campaign. A 27-year-old man with pale platinum-blond textured crop, clean-shaven, confident blue-gray gaze; a 29-year-old woman with sleek golden-blond chin-length bob, relaxed smile and assured eye contact. Reference 1 is exact ORBITA LIME ACID cotton T-shirt with tiny PURPLE SATURN micrographic on left chest: man wears it neatly untucked over ivory tailored wide trousers with side adjusters, minimal dark belt and clean offwhite shoes. Reference 2 is exact ISLA BRAVA vivid BUGANVILLA PINK tee with tiny PAPAYA flower on left chest: woman wears it with crisp saturated PAPAYA ORANGE high-waist wide trousers and minimal ivory sandals. Keep both micrographics at original modest scale, not oversized, no added logos. Vivid near-fluorescent lime and hot pink matte cotton, bright but not glowing; elegant adult summer styling, no festival costumes. Courtyard of a modern art museum, cobalt blue tiled wall, sun-yellow low plinth, rough concrete pavers with small chips and marks, a little blurred greenery, clear afternoon daylight. Both bodies head to shoes fully in frame, generous top and side breathing room, asymmetrical loose poses about a meter apart, hands don't cover prints, natural fit and fabric drape. Shot like a real 35mm f/5.6 fashion photographer, fine grain, natural pores and wispy hairs, accurate saturated fabrics and soft highlights. No sunglasses obscuring eyes, handbags, foreign brands, outside text, artificial CGI skin, collage or watermark.
